name: Hammuel
title: Descendant of Simeon
summary: Hammuel is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Simeon, the son of Jacob. He is the son of Mishma and is listed in the genealogy of the tribe of Simeon. He plays no prominent narrative role in the Bible but is part of the important genealogical records documenting the history of Israel's tribes.
relatedPersons: Simon-Jacob's son with Leah, father of the tribe of Simeon

keyEvents.title: Listed in the genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Hammuel is listed as the son of Mishma in the genealogical record of the tribe of Simeon in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of the tribe of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Hammuel is part of the broader overview of Simeon's descendants who settled in various areas of the Promised Land.

keyEvents.title: Settlements of the tribe of Simeon
keyEvents.description: The context surrounding Hammuel's lineage describes how the tribe of Simeon settled and lived in their allotted territories.

keyEvents.title: The Origin of the Tribe of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Simeon, the ancestor of Hamuel, was a son of Jacob and Leah, and the founder of one of Israel's twelve tribes.
